claims.rule: For scope-propagation changes across prefetch, channels or parallel evaluation, test later per-element acquisitions as well as an initially open resource; also check inherited interruption before, inside and after any new scope boundary.
claims.applicability: Inference from two closed-unmerged proposals in CE3-era FS2. A lease is not a subscription to future allocations, and forcing interruptibility is not restoring inherited interruptibility. These are review probes, not an implementation endorsement of extendScopeThrough or noInterruptScope.
claims.counterexample: A single outer bracket can pass the proposed test while bracket-per-element resources opened on later pulls close too early. Explicitly making a traced inner stream interruptible can break a parent that intentionally disabled interruption.
